records.question: On how many days and between which dates were photo-identification and biopsy sampling performed in American Samoa according to the abstract?
records.ground_truth_answer: They were performed on 27 days between September 18 and October 7, 2003–2005.
ground_truth_chunks: Here we describe the results of photo-identification and biopsy sampling performed on 27 days between September 18 and October 7, 2003-2005.
